title: Juicy Velvety Filipino Herring Dinuguan
description: A rich and flavorful Filipino dish made with herring, a mother sauce base, and various spices, resulting in a velvety texture and floral notes. This pescatarian-friendly dish is perfect for a solo dinner.

ingredients.name: herring fillets
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small pieces

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the herring pieces and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the vinegar, fish sauce, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the tomato paste and water, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the sauce until it is smooth and velvety.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the dinuguan hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of black pepper.
